target.population: Individual Brazilian Mortality Information System cancer death records
target.effect_scale: Odds ratio per 10 micrograms per cubic metre
target.exposure_assignment: Population-weighted municipal mean of 0.25-degree daily PM2.5 grids; lag 0-2 three-day mean
target.model: Time-stratified case-crossover conditional logistic regression; same weekday within calendar month controls

substitutions.reason: The first complete public annual SIM member recovered under the predeclared byte-range design.

substitutions.reanalysis: Equal-station mean of observed CETESB PM2.5 monitors
substitutions.reason: The public monitor archive supplied daily observed PM2.5 for a bounded city slice.

substitutions.published: Temperature cross-basis, relative humidity, public holiday
substitutions.reason: No daily covariate series was recovered into the bounded fit.

coverage.rule: Predeclared Sao Paulo 2019 subset; retain days with a complete three-day PM2.5 mean.
coverage.notes: 363 of 365 days had complete lag 0-2 exposure. The daily input panel is expanded by death event and same-weekday/calendar-month referents into 68,454 conditional-logistic rows for 15,647 cancer-death events.

blockers: This is not a nationwide replication: it covers one municipality and one year.
The exposure is a city monitor-network mean rather than the published population-weighted grid.
Temperature, relative humidity, and holiday adjustment are omitted.

design_provenance.assignment_method: Municipality-code assignment joining CODMUNRES to CODE_MUNI; use population weighting only when public grid/population support is recovered.
design_provenance.monitor_distance_evidence: Not applicable to the selected assignment method.
design_provenance.exposure_metric: Municipality-level PM2.5 lag 0–2 three-day arithmetic mean in micrograms per cubic metre.

coverage_policy.evidence: Report-only; fit requires nonmissing daily cancer outcome, three PM2.5 values, and recoverable covariates; no unsupported numeric threshold.

design_provenance.decision_rationale: Defines an executable exposure and panel plan for the required fresh recovery attempt without modifying outcome, pollutant, lag construct, geography, contrast, or model family.
evidence_basis: Abstract specifies individual cancer deaths in Brazilian municipalities, daily PM2.5, 2000–2019, and a three-day PM2.5 mean.
Target supplies time-stratified case-crossover conditional regression and weather/holiday covariates.
Public source documents daily municipality linkage via CODMUNRES and CODE_MUNI.
Review requires an evidence-backed executable design and fresh counterexample recovery.

effects.label: All-cancer mortality, Sao Paulo 2019 bounded sensitivity
effects.contrast: per 10 micrograms per cubic metre PM2.5
effects.native_contrast: per 1 microgram per cubic metre PM2.5

reported_variants: Unadjusted bounded Sao Paulo 2019 all-cancer sensitivity; event-expanded case-crossover panel
